decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (L382/03/A and L382/4/A received 30 June 2011; L382/5/C received 3 July 2011; and LP/01 received 11 May 2011) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side wall of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The side windows hereby approved shall be finished in obscure glazing and the side window shall not be openable below 1.7 metres above finished floor level and this arrangement shall be permanently retained
description: Erection of a two storey side and a part two storey part single storey rear extension and a side and rear roof extension
